quest.title: Invisible Barrier
quest.description: Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: You went to the Transparent Ruins? Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course. Be prepared to be thunderstruck!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You recount your exploration of the Transparent Ruins to Soheil and give him the three stone slates.

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: Aha! So King Deshret did indeed withhold a secret behind that unknown force. I shall get to the bottom of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you look pale... Did you discover something terrible?

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: Uh... No, sorry, they're not exactly "terrible"... The writings on the stone slates look complicated, but they're actually... Records of leave requests.

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: In addition, the recorded excuses are not any different from that of the young scholars today...

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: Phew, it's a good thing I failed to find a way to access the Transparent Ruins back in the day. I imagine that I would have been quite livid.

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: Anyway, I must thank you for bringing the slates back. Perhaps I should go ask around about the excuses people make in Mondstadt. That could be enough for me to write a paper...

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: "Time Out From a Busy Schedule: On the Evolution of the Perception of Off-Days in Different Societies."
